background_image_description: Retro sunburst background filling the entire 1600x1131 canvas with alternating wide radial rays in muted teal (#2f9a93) and brick red (#c95543) over a cream base (#f4eedc). Rays emanate from the center behind a large central oval; edges are softly rounded for a vintage poster feel.

nodes.svg_description: Large horizontal white ellipse centered on the canvas with a solid black (#1f1f1f) outline and a thick dark crescent shadow along the lower-left edge. The ellipse fill is white (#ffffff); stroke width ~14px. The shadow appears as a charcoal (#2a2a2a) offset elliptical arc overlapping the outline from roughly 210° to 330°, giving a drop-shadow effect.
Four-pointed diamond burst (cartoon star) overlapping the oval at the upper-left. Fill brick red (#c95543), thin black (#1f1f1f) outline. Softly rounded points oriented at ~45°.
Four-pointed diamond burst overlapping the oval at the lower-right. Fill brick red (#c95543), thin black (#1f1f1f) outline. Similar shape to the upper-left burst, mirrored.

Cartoon lightning bolt at the top-right: white fill (#ffffff) with black outline (#1f1f1f) and a narrow brick red (#c95543) accent stroke running along the right edge of the bolt. Angular zig-zag shape with three segments.

Cartoon lightning bolt at the lower-left: white fill (#ffffff) with black outline (#1f1f1f) and a narrow brick red (#c95543) accent stroke along the right edge. Slightly shorter and rotated counterclockwise.
